experiences.name: Mercado de San Juan Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore one of Mexico City's most beloved gourmet markets, sampling exotic cheeses, fresh seafood tostadas, traditional tacos, and artisanal products. Chat with local vendors and taste authentic Mexican flavors in a vibrant market setting.

experiences.name: Museo Nacional de Antropología Visit
experiences.description: Discover one of the world's greatest anthropology museums, housing the famous Aztec Sun Stone and thousands of pre-Columbian artifacts. Gain deep insight into Mexico's rich indigenous civilizations including the Maya, Aztec, and Olmec cultures.

experiences.name: Coyoacán Neighborhood Walking Tour & Frida Kahlo Museum
experiences.description: Stroll through the charming cobblestone streets of Coyoacán, visit the iconic Casa Azul (Frida Kahlo Museum), browse artisan markets, and sip traditional hot chocolate at a local café. A perfect blend of art, history, and local culture.

experiences.name: Street Taco Crawl in Roma & Condesa
experiences.description: Embark on a self-guided evening taco crawl through the trendy Roma and Condesa neighborhoods. Sample al pastor, suadero, and barbacoa tacos from legendary street stands, wash them down with agua fresca, and soak in the lively local nightlife atmosphere.

experiences.name: Teotihuacán Pyramids Day Trip
experiences.description: Take a day trip to the ancient pre-Aztec city of Teotihuacán, climb the Pyramid of the Sun and Moon, explore the Avenue of the Dead, and learn about one of Mesoamerica's most powerful civilizations. A breathtaking cultural and historical experience just outside the city.
experiences.location: Teotihuacán, State of Mexico (45 km northeast of Mexico City)
